about: Tennis's defaults, as data (docs/PLAN-start-a-game-gpt.md track L, L5 part 4b): a sport's standard scoring, lineup slots and locks, and the game specs a sport's Make it a game starts from instead of asking the bot. Stat keys are tennis's (src/lib/sports/tennis.ts), one vocabulary for both tours. ESPN gives a match's score alone (its sets, games and tiebreaks, who won, a retirement or a walkover), so what a standard table scores from a match's statistics (aces, double faults, breaks of serve) isn't scored here. A best-of-five match (a Grand Slam's men's singles) scores by its own table (`byFormat`, by its sets: Bout.rounds). The specs are in the game spec's shape; slots aren't in that schema yet (L4 adds them), so they're kept beside it for the spec to read.

scoring.source: DraftKings' tennis (its classic contests, as rotowire.com/tennis/article.php?id=40548 gives its table, updated 2018-07-24; actionnetwork.com's Wimbledon guide agrees on its aces and breaks; DraftKings' own rules page answers a 403): best of three, a match played 30, a game won 2.5 and lost -2, a set won 6 and lost -3, a match won 6, a clean set (won without losing a game) 4, straight sets 6, and a win by the opponent's retirement in the 1st set 20, the 2nd 15, the 3rd 10 with the match won (so 14, 9 and 4 on top of it); best of five (byFormat 5), a match played 30, a game won 2 and lost -1.6, a set won 5 and lost -2.5, a match won 5, a clean set 2.5, straight sets 5, and a retirement in the 1st set 20, the 2nd 16, the 3rd 12, the 4th or 5th 8 with the match won (15, 11, 7 and 3 on top). Left out, ESPN having no match statistics: an ace (0.4; 0.25 in best of five), a double fault (-1), a break of serve (0.75; 0.5), no double fault (2.5; 5), 10 or more aces (2; 15 or more in best of five). A walkover isn't in the table read (DraftKings' rules page wasn't readable): a walkover isn't a match played, so it scores nothing here

categories.source: DraftKings' tennis scores points, not categories (Yahoo, ESPN and FanDuel run no tennis game): none by default

slots.source: DraftKings' tennis: six players (any six of a day's slate, one tour's; its $50,000 salary cap isn't a slot)

season.about: A season of events: draft 6 players, each scores in every match they play, most points over the season wins.

short.about: One event: everyone drafts a few players, every one of them scores in each match they play, most points wins.
